requirement: Voice authentication localizes public guides and parses private confirmation and OTP locally

oracle.invariant: Only language and fixed public templates reach translation; credentials and private history are rejected before inference. Invalid placeholders, confirmation collisions and unchanged English guides for another language fail closed. Cached concurrent language requests translate once; unavailable localization never silently switches to English. French spoken email, oui and six French digits verify on the same microphone after explicit confirmation, without credentials in model turns. Unicode decimal digits and localized non-Latin digit words parse exactly; surrounding unknown words and excess digits are refused.
oracle.productSourcesScope: file-level: the files the case imports, reads or runs (declaration line, or the first code line); the invariant is exercised through them, the executed assertion is the case command
productSourcesUnresolved: apps/tracy-web/src/widget/route.js:542 readFile() with a computed path

writes: run dir under QA_ARTIFACT_ROOT: logs/, tmp/<case> (the child TMPDIR, removed after the run)

locale lexicon handles spoken email, localized readback, Unicode digits and non-Latin six-digit words
